data.long_meaning: The name Alper is believed to have originated from the Greek word 'alpēs,' which means 'rock.' It can also be derived from the Latin word 'alper,' which means 'noble one.' This strong and steadfast name is a great choice for a boy looking for a name with a solid foundation. The name Alper carries the meaning “Rock or noble one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alper usually hope their child will grow to embody rock or noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
